text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, deforestation did occur on the asset in 2023. The data shows a tree-cover loss of 0.7 hectares, which is 1.2% of the asset's area. This loss was observed by the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13). Additionally, the European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020 data corroborates that the area was mapped as forest in 2020. The loss area was primarily planted forest, with no native forest affected.
